meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 把 GitHub 上大量问题报告按根本原因分成小组，每组建立一个计划主问题，用统一评论关闭子问题，并打包一个能一次关闭整组的修复 PR。最后所有打开的 issue 就是这些计划主问题。
howto.when: 当仓库有20个以上开放 issue，或你提出“整理”、“归并”、“去重”等，或要求制定计划、判断新 bug 归属时触发。

say.text: 把仓库所有开放问题按根本原因聚类成计划主问题。
这个新 bug 属于哪个计划？帮我归并进去。
say.note: Claude 会匹配现有计划，追加评论后关闭该 bug。

say.text: 为这个计划生成一个打包 PR，自动关闭所有子问题。
say.note: Claude 会写出含 Closes #N 的 PR 描述。

howto.what_en: Groups a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a few plan-master issues, closes children with a standard redirect comment, and bundles architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Ends with open issues == open plans.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a repo has 20+ open issues, when asked to triage/consolidate/cluster/dedupe issues, or when deciding whether a new bug belongs to an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster all open issues in this repo by root cause into plan masters.
say_en.note: Claude reads everything, creates masters, and closes children.

say_en.text: Does this new bug belong to an existing plan? Fold it in.
say_en.note: Claude matches the master, adds a Round N comment, closes it.

say_en.text: Bundle the issues in this plan into one fixing PR.
say_en.note: Claude writes a PR body with Closes #N for each child.
